chart.$description: Component-level tokens for data visualization. Series colors come from the CVD-safe chart ramp, which the high-contrast themes already remap. Charts must never convey meaning through color alone — pair every series with a direct label, pattern, or marker shape. Ported from finance's design-tokens package and re-expressed against Studio's t-shirt spacing and radius scales.

bg.$description: Plot area background — inherits the page surface so charts sit flush.

radius.$description: Chart container corner radius. Matches card radius.

padding.$description: Padding between the container edge and the plot area.

min-height.$description: Floor for a legible plot area. Below this, axis labels collide and a chart stops being readable faster than it stops fitting.

default-height.$description: Height a chart takes when the layout expresses no preference.

max-height.$description: Ceiling, so a chart in a tall container does not crowd out everything beneath it.

grid.$description: Grid line color. Render grid lines at reduced opacity rather than with a separate token, so the axis stays dominant without adding a theme-parity surface.

swatch-size.$description: Legend color swatch size. Deliberately not on the 4px grid's spacing scale: this is a glyph dimension, not a layout gap, and it is sized to sit optically with the legend label rather than with the layout.

tooltip-shadow.$description: Tooltip elevation, so it reads above the plot area.

slice-stroke.$description: Separator stroke between pie or donut slices. Matches the background so slices read as separated rather than outlined.

slice-stroke-width.$description: Width of the slice separator. Studio already had the stroke color but not its width, so every consumer picked one and adjacent slices merged at different thresholds.

donut-inner-ratio.$description: Inner radius as a fraction of the outer radius. A ratio rather than a length so the hole scales with the chart instead of swallowing it at small sizes.

line-width.$description: Line series stroke width. Matches the slice separator so strokes across chart types read as one weight.

dot-radius.$description: Data point marker radius on a line series. Markers are required, not decorative: they are what makes a series distinguishable without relying on color.

dot-radius-active.$description: Marker radius for the hovered or focused point. The size change is the non-color signal for the active point.

empty-icon.$description: Glyph on the no-data state. Finance used text.disabled, which measured 1.24:1 in light. Strictly this icon is decorative — the empty-state text is required alongside it, so WCAG 1.4.11 does not apply — but an invisible icon is not a subtle icon, it is a missing one. Raised to the same value as the accompanying text.

empty-text.$description: Explanatory copy on the no-data state. Always required: a chart with no data must say why, never render blank.

enter-duration.$description: Series entrance. Shares the progress duration because both animate a value growing into place, and both collapse to 1ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

transition-duration.$description: Transition when the underlying data changes without the chart being re-entered.

series-other.$description: Grouped tail categories rendered as a single "Other" series. Neutral by design, so it never competes with a real series.
